messages:
ana (Marketing): Heads-up: planning release announce for 'Wave' next Tue 09:00am PT. Need canonical docs URL, final changelog, short bench paragraph + 3 bullets, and a staging webhook for registrant routing by EOD Mon.
ben (Engineering): On changelog PR #9182. I'll add the staged-rollout windows and the rollback CLI. Will paste the Dedicated migration snippet there.
ana (Marketing): @ben small ask: can the changelog include the exact canary percentages and timing? Marketing wants to call out the 'staggered waves' approach in the post.
ben (Engineering): Yep. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% at 30m -> 60% at 90m -> full at 3h if metrics OK. Rollback: `rictl rollback --release wave --to previous`.
charlie (Product): Webinar confirmed Thu 11am PT. We need a 25-word promo line, a 1-paragraph bench summary, and 3 bullets for slides (latency/cost/consistency). Also confirm inbound mapping to SFDC fields.
ben (Engineering): Bench draft: "Wave reduces median latency on medium-context prompts by ~26% and drops per-token cost ~22% using adaptive batching and quantized kernels; optional session caching preserves p95 under load."
ben (Engineering): Bullets: 1) ~26% median latency improvement (4k context), 2) ~22% per-token cost reduction via adaptive batching+quant, 3) optional session cache for stable p95 under sustained traffic.
nicole (Docs): I'll publish a stable /docs/wave-release page once PR merges. Please include the Dedicated migration snippet and the sample `wave.yaml` config so I can copy examples.
nana (Marketing): Promo (25w) request: trim bench para to ~25 words and give a 1-line CTA for the webinar.
ben (Engineering): Promo (25w): "Wave cuts median latency ~26% and lowers per-token cost ~22% with adaptive batching and quant kernels; includes optional session caching for steady p95."
charlie (Product): For lead routing: GTM ops needs a staging webhook endpoint. Ops, can we get `https://hooks.staging.redwood/growth/wave-reg` with a test API key? We'll validate mapping to SFDC lead.owner, lead.source.
gto-bot: Webhook endpoint created (staging): https://hooks.staging.redwood/growth/wave-reg — test key minted, expires in 7d.
nicole (Docs): Once changelog merges I'll publish and drop canonical link here. ETA tomorrow AM.
nana (Marketing): Great — once canonical link is here I'll lock the post and schedule the publish. Also want a short snippet for the release notes about Dedicated vs Hosted behavior (1 sentence).
ben (Engineering): Sentence for notes: "Dedicated customers may need a minor config change for the session cache; see the Dedicated migration example in the docs."
nana (Marketing): Perfect. I'll assemble the post and slide bullets tonight and ping for final links. :rocket:
